name: Pull Request Beyla Integration Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: "${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}"
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  integration-tests:
    name: Beyla Integration Tests
    runs-on: self-hosted
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - script: scripts/generate-integration-matrix.sh
            weights_file: scripts/integration-test-weights.generated.json
            test_type: integration
          - script: scripts/generate-integration-matrix.sh
            weights_file: scripts/beyla-integration-test-weights.json
            test_type: beyla-integration
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@40f1582b2485089dde7abd97c1529aa768e1baff # v5.6.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: false

      - name: Generate test matrix
        id: generate-matrix
        run: |
          export WEIGHTS_FILE="${{ matrix.weights_file }}"
          echo "matrix=$(bash ${{ matrix.script }})" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: |
          make test-integration
        env:
          TEST_INTEGRATION_MATRIX: ${{ steps.generate-matrix.outputs.matrix }}
          TEST_INTEGRATION_TYPE: ${{ matrix.test_type }}

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: EnricoMi/publish-unit-test-result-action@v2
        if: always()
        with:
          files: testoutput/*.xml
          check_name: Integration Tests Results
